notes: Group (sheet sub-heading): Battle Of Kashyyyk. SYSTEM, Light half only (short landscape slip, like Corellia #27): two blue sabers in the Force slot (light_force_count 2, as printed), bar '•KASHYYYK' (red dot), planet icon box, parsec 6. Right margin: black EPISODE I disc above the VS16 sphere → icons ['episode1'] (not on the printed card). ▼ starts the slip's second line. Dark half not on the slip → printed Dark text kept (dark_text), Dark Force (one red saber) and planet icon as printed. The stub's game text is garbled: '▼' was expanded as 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' — the slip simply prints ▼ (deploy from Reserve Deck). Stub's base link [[Kashyyyk (Light)]] does not exist; base = [[Kashyyyk]] (ANH Light). Systems have no lore. 350 px scan only; copyright ANH 1996 by set. Modern: VB5-L-kashyyyk-pre.gif (350, different text). Art: card area measured on the scan (art.bbox) — the auto border detection lost the starfield edges (Bill).
